eras.note: Assumed decennial map preceding the current one; this project's data begins in 2016, so its earlier years are outside the checked range.

eras.label: current
eras.note: Structure unchanged from prior decades: 17 two-member districts (34 senators total) with staggered 4-year terms, one seat per district up each even-year cycle. Veto override on ordinary bills is only a majority of elected members; budget/appropriations bills require 2/3 (23 seats) instead.

redistricting.text: Kept 95% of its population from the 2016–2020 SD-1; gained the rest from the old SD-2 (5%). Spans Ohio, Hancock, Brooke, Marshall counties. 2020 presidential margin R+36.4 on the 2016–2020 lines → R+37.7 on the current lines.
